          var _priority = materializationData.GetPropertyValue<int>("priority");
          var _embedding = materializationData.GetPropertyValue<global::Pgvector.Vector?>("embedding");
          row.Data = row.Data with { Status = _status, Size = _size ?? row.Data.Size, Priority = _priority, Embedding = _embedding is not null ? _embedding.ToArray() : row.Data.Embedding };
        });

        // Register ChangeTracker-based hydrator for global::TestApp.TicketModel (zero reflection, AOT-safe)
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SplitModeChangeTrackerHydrator.Register(typeof(global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.TicketModel>), entry => {
          var row = (global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.TicketModel>)entry.Entity;

        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.QueryTranslation.PhysicalFieldRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.CaseModel>("Status", "status", isVector: false);

        // Register ChangeTracker-based hydrator for global::TestApp.CaseModel (zero reflection, AOT-safe)
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SplitModeChangeTrackerHydrator.Register(typeof(global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.CaseModel>), entry => {

          entry.State = Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.EntityState.Detached;
        });

        // Register the Split document projection for global::TestApp.CaseModel (zero reflection, AOT-safe)
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SplitDocumentRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.CaseModel>(
          r => Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SplitDocumentRegistry.WithColumns(r.Data, new object?[] { global::Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.EF.Property<string>(r, "status"), global::Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.EF.Property<int?>(r, "size") }),
          (data, columns) => {
          var row = new Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SplitDocumentRegistry.Document<global::TestApp.CaseModel>(data);
          var _status = (string)columns[0]!;
          var _size = (int?)columns[1];
          row.Data = new global::TestApp.CaseModel { Id = row.Data.Id, Status = _status, Size = _size ?? row.Data.Size, Note = row.Data.Note };
          return row.Data;
        });

        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.QueryTranslation.PhysicalFieldRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.OrderModel>("Total", "total", isVector: false);

        // Register physical field hydrator for global::TestApp.OrderModel
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.PhysicalFieldHydratorRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.OrderModel>((materializationData, entity) => {
          var row = (global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.OrderModel>)entity;
          if (row.Data is null) return; // ComplexProperty().ToJson() materializes Data after InitializedInstance
          var _total = materializationData.GetPropertyValue<decimal>("total");
          row.Data.Total = _total;
        });

        // Register ChangeTracker-based hydrator for global::TestApp.OrderModel (zero reflection, AOT-safe)
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SplitModeChangeTrackerHydrator.Register(typeof(global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.OrderModel>), entry => {
          var row = (global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.OrderModel>)entry.Entity;
          if (row.Data is null) { return; }
          var _total = (decimal)entry.Property("total").CurrentValue!;
          row.Data.Total = _total;
          entry.State = Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.EntityState.Detached;
        });

        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.QueryTranslation.StreamIdRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.ItemModel>("Id");
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.QueryTranslation.StreamIdRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.TicketModel>("Id");
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.QueryTranslation.StreamIdRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.CaseModel>("Id");
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.QueryTranslation.StreamIdRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.OrderModel>("Id");
        // WORKAROUND(dotnet/efcore#38625): EF Core 10 ComplexProperty().ToJson() materializes JSON-absent
        // complex collections as null (old-shape rows after schema evolution); coalesce to empty on
        // materialization so reads don't NRE and tracked saves pass PrepareToSave. Remove when fixed upstream (dotnet/efcore#39014).
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.PerspectiveDataCoalescer.Register(typeof(global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.ItemModel>), entity => {
          var row = (global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.ItemModel>)entity;
          if (row.Scope is not null) { row.Scope.Extensions ??= new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.ScopeExtension>(); }
        });

        // WORKAROUND(dotnet/efcore#38625): EF Core 10 ComplexProperty().ToJson() materializes JSON-absent
        // complex collections as null (old-shape rows after schema evolution); coalesce to empty on
        // materialization so reads don't NRE and tracked saves pass PrepareToSave. Remove when fixed upstream (dotnet/efcore#39014).
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.PerspectiveDataCoalescer.Register(typeof(global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.TicketModel>), entity => {
          var row = (global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.TicketModel>)entity;
          if (row.Scope is not null) { row.Scope.Extensions ??= new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.ScopeExtension>(); }
        });

        // WORKAROUND(dotnet/efcore#38625): EF Core 10 ComplexProperty().ToJson() materializes JSON-absent
        // complex collections as null (old-shape rows after schema evolution); coalesce to empty on
        // materialization so reads don't NRE and tracked saves pass PrepareToSave. Remove when fixed upstream (dotnet/efcore#39014).
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.PerspectiveDataCoalescer.Register(typeof(global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.CaseModel>), entity => {
          var row = (global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.CaseModel>)entity;
          if (row.Scope is not null) { row.Scope.Extensions ??= new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.ScopeExtension>(); }
        });

        // WORKAROUND(dotnet/efcore#38625): EF Core 10 ComplexProperty().ToJson() materializes JSON-absent
        // complex collections as null (old-shape rows after schema evolution); coalesce to empty on
        // materialization so reads don't NRE and tracked saves pass PrepareToSave. Remove when fixed upstream (dotnet/efcore#39014).
        Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.PerspectiveDataCoalescer.Register(typeof(global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.OrderModel>), entity => {
          var row = (global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.PerspectiveRow<global::TestApp.OrderModel>)entity;
          if (row.Scope is not null) { row.Scope.Extensions ??= new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<global::Whizbang.Core.Lenses.ScopeExtension>(); }
          var data = row.Data;
          if (data is null) { return; }
          data.Lines ??= new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<global::TestApp.LineItem>();
        });

        // Auto-detected: ILensQuery<TestApp.OrderModel, TestApp.ItemModel> (from TestApp.OrderReport)
        services.AddTransient<Whizbang.Core.Lenses.ILensQuery<global::TestApp.OrderModel, global::TestApp.ItemModel>>(sp => {
          global::Whizbang.Core.Workers.ReadModelsGuard.ThrowIfNotReady(sp);
          var factory = sp.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.IDbContextFactory<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>>();
          var context = factory.CreateDbContext();
          var tableNames = new global::System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<global::System.Type, string> {
            [typeof(global::TestApp.OrderModel)] = "wh_per_order",
            [typeof(global::TestApp.ItemModel)] = "wh_per_item"
          };
          var scopeContextAccessor = sp.GetRequiredService<global::Whizbang.Core.Security.IScopeContextAccessor>();
          var whizbangOptions = sp.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions<global::Whizbang.Core.Configuration.WhizbangCoreOptions>>();
          return new Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.EFCorePostgresLensQuery<global::TestApp.OrderModel, global::TestApp.ItemModel>(context, tableNames, scopeContextAccessor, whizbangOptions);
        });

        services.TryAddKeyedSingleton<global::Whizbang.Core.Capabilities.ICapabilityRequirementSource>(typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext), new global::Whizbang.Core.Capabilities.FixedCapabilityRequirementSource(global::TestApp.Generated.TestDbContextSchemaExtensions.GetCapabilityRequirements()));
        services.TryAddKeyedSingleton<global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.Schema.ManagedSchemaManifest>(typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext), new global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.Schema.ManagedSchemaManifest(
          typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext), "testapp", global::TestApp.Generated.TestDbContextSchemaExtensions.GetManagedSchemaObjects));
      }

    });

    // Register DbContext callback for TestDbContext
    // Default connection string: "db" (can be overridden via WithEFCore<T>("name"))
    DbContextRegistrationRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>((services, connectionStringNameOverride) => {

      // Use override if provided, otherwise fall back to attribute/derived default
      var connectionStringKey = connectionStringNameOverride ?? "db";
      // Read only when nothing is configured under the key (see ResolveConnectionStringName).
      var legacyConnectionStringKey = connectionStringNameOverride is null ? "test-db" : null;

      // Funnel the resolved key through to Whizbang notification options so the
      // LISTEN/NOTIFY + commit-order stamper resolver looks up the same
      // ConnectionStrings:{Key}-direct / ConnectionStrings:{Key} entries EF Core uses.
      // Without this, the EF wiring and the notification wiring can derive different
      // names (e.g., when [WhizbangDbContext(ConnectionStringName=...)] disagrees with
      // the class-name convention), and notifications silently fall back to the pooled
      // (pgbouncer) connection. Guarded so an explicit Whizbang:Database:ConnectionStringKey
      // in appsettings still wins.
      services.AddOptions<global::Whizbang.Core.Notifications.WhizbangNotificationOptions>().PostConfigure<global::System.IServiceProvider>((opts, sp) => {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(opts.ConnectionStringKey)) {
          opts.ConnectionStringKey = global::Whizbang.Core.Naming.WhizbangNamingConvention.ResolveConnectionStringName(
            sp.GetService<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>(), connectionStringKey, legacyConnectionStringKey);
        }
      });

      // Remove any existing NpgsqlDataSource registration (e.g., from Aspire)
      services.RemoveAll<Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSource>();

      // Register NpgsqlDataSource via a singleton factory. IConfiguration is
      // resolved from the REAL provider's `sp` when the factory runs: no temp
      // container, no host ConfigurationManager disposal, IOptionsMonitor /
      // IFeatureManager / appsettings reloadOnChange / AAC refresh all stay alive.
      services.AddSingleton<Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSource>(sp => {
        var config = sp.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>();
        var resolvedConnectionStringKey = global::Whizbang.Core.Naming.WhizbangNamingConvention.ResolveConnectionStringName(
            config, connectionStringKey, legacyConnectionStringKey,
            sp.GetService<global::Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILoggerFactory>()?.CreateLogger("Whizbang.ConnectionStrings"));
        // A key present with a blank value is no connection string (#1660).
        var connectionString = config.GetConnectionString(resolvedConnectionStringKey) is { } configured && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured)
            ? configured
            : throw new InvalidOperationException($"Connection string '{resolvedConnectionStringKey}' not found in configuration.");

        // Apply connection pool settings from configuration (ConnectionPool section)
        var connStringBuilder = new Npgsql.NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
        var poolSection = config.GetSection("ConnectionPool");
        if (poolSection.Exists()) {
          if (int.TryParse(poolSection["MaxPoolSize"], out var maxPool))
            connStringBuilder.MaxPoolSize = maxPool;
          if (int.TryParse(poolSection["MinPoolSize"], out var minPool))
            connStringBuilder.MinPoolSize = minPool;
          if (int.TryParse(poolSection["Timeout"], out var timeout))
            connStringBuilder.Timeout = timeout;
          if (int.TryParse(poolSection["CommandTimeout"], out var commandTimeout))
            connStringBuilder.CommandTimeout = commandTimeout;
        }
        // This connection's own timeout key wins (Whizbang:Postgres:<name>:CommandTimeoutSeconds).
        global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.PostgresCommandTimeouts.Apply(config, resolvedConnectionStringKey, connStringBuilder);
        // #2347: a connection behind a transaction-mode pooler stops sending DISCARD ALL on every return.
        global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.PostgresTransactionPooler.Apply(config, resolvedConnectionStringKey, connStringBuilder);
        connectionString = connStringBuilder.ToString();

        var dataSourceBuilder = new Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(connectionString);
        dataSourceBuilder.ConfigureJsonOptions(global::Whizbang.Core.Serialization.JsonContextRegistry.CreateCombinedOptions());
        dataSourceBuilder.EnableDynamicJson();

        // Auto-configured: pgvector support required for [VectorField] columns
        dataSourceBuilder.UseVector();

        // pgvector exists before Build(), so Npgsql's pg_type catalog scan finds it. The helper leaves an
        // installed extension alone and fails start naming the vector columns and the fix when it is refused.
        using (var tempConn = new Npgsql.NpgsqlConnection(connectionString)) {
          global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.PostgresRequiredExtension.EnsureAsync(tempConn, "vector", "db", global::TestApp.Generated.TestDbContextSchemaExtensions.GetCapabilityRequirements(), default).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }

        return dataSourceBuilder.Build();
      });

      // Remove any existing DbContext registration (e.g., from manual AddDbContext calls)
      // to avoid conflicts with our registration
      services.RemoveAll<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContextOptions<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>>();
      services.RemoveAll<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>();
      services.RemoveAll<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.IDbContextFactory<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>>();

      // DbContext registration resolves the NpgsqlDataSource via `sp` at build time
      // ((sp, options) AddDbContext overload). Defers all dependency resolution to
      // the real provider: no temp container, no CM disposal.
      services.AddDbContext<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>((sp, options) => {
        options.UseNpgsql(sp.GetRequiredService<Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSource>(), npgsqlOptions => {
          npgsqlOptions.UseVector();
          // Whizbang custom function translators (JsonbSet, etc.), required for collective-apply ExecuteUpdate.
          npgsqlOptions.UseWhizbangFunctions();
          npgsqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3, maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5), errorCodesToAdd: null);
        });
        options.UseWhizbangPhysicalFields();
      });
      services.TryAddKeyedSingleton<global::Whizbang.Core.Capabilities.ICapabilityRequirementSource>(typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext), new global::Whizbang.Core.Capabilities.FixedCapabilityRequirementSource(global::TestApp.Generated.TestDbContextSchemaExtensions.GetCapabilityRequirements()));
      services.RemoveAllKeyed<global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.Schema.ManagedSchemaManifest>(typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext));
      services.AddKeyedSingleton<global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.Schema.ManagedSchemaManifest>(typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext), new global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.Schema.ManagedSchemaManifest(
        typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext), "testapp", global::TestApp.Generated.TestDbContextSchemaExtensions.GetManagedSchemaObjects));
      services.RemoveAllKeyed<global::Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SchemaInitConnection>(typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext));
      services.AddKeyedSingleton<global::Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SchemaInitConnection>(typeof(global::TestApp.TestDbContext), (sp, _) =>
        global::Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SchemaInitConnection.FromConfiguration(
          sp.GetService<global::Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>(), "db", "test-db"));

      // Register IDbContextFactory<T> as singleton for HotChocolate parallel resolver support
      // ScopedDbContextFactory creates a scope for each CreateDbContext() call,
      // avoiding scope validation issues that AddPooledDbContextFactory causes
      services.AddSingleton<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.IDbContextFactory<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>>(sp =>
        new global::Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.ScopedDbContextFactory<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>(
          sp.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceScopeFactory>()));

      // Register JsonSerializerOptions for Whizbang components
      services.AddSingleton(global::Whizbang.Core.Serialization.JsonContextRegistry.CreateCombinedOptions());
      services.TryAddSingleton<global::Whizbang.Core.Observability.ILibraryVersionProvider>(
        new global::Whizbang.Core.Observability.LibraryVersionProvider("{LIBRARY_VERSION}"));
    });

    // Register initialization callback for EnsureWhizbangInitializedAsync()
    // This enables turnkey initialization via app.EnsureWhizbangInitializedAsync()
    // Supports optional '{Name}-init' connection string to bypass PgBouncer for DDL
    DbContextInitializationRegistry.Register<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>(async (sp, logger, ct) => {
      using var scope = sp.CreateScope();

      // Convention: try "{Name}-init" connection string first (direct Postgres, bypasses PgBouncer)
      var config = scope.ServiceProvider.GetService<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>();
      var initConnectionStringKey = global::Whizbang.Core.Naming.WhizbangNamingConvention.ResolveConnectionStringName(config, "db", "test-db", logger);
      // A blank -init key is no -init connection: SchemaInitConnection reads it as none (#1660).
      var initConnStr = new global::Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SchemaInitConnection(config?.GetConnectionString(initConnectionStringKey + "-init")).ConnectionString;
      // Schema initialization's own timeout key (Whizbang:Postgres:<name>-init:CommandTimeoutSeconds), with or without an -init string.
      var initCommandTimeoutSeconds = global::Whizbang.Data.Postgres.PostgresCommandTimeouts.Configured(config, initConnectionStringKey + "-init");

      if (initConnStr != null) {
        if (logger is not null) {
          Whizbang.Data.EFCore.Postgres.SchemaInitializationLog.UsingInitConnectionString(logger, initConnectionStringKey);
        }
        // Build dedicated DbContext with direct Postgres connection for initialization
        var initDsBuilder = new Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(initConnStr);
        var jsonOptions = global::Whizbang.Core.Serialization.JsonContextRegistry.CreateCombinedOptions();
        initDsBuilder.ConfigureJsonOptions(jsonOptions);
        initDsBuilder.EnableDynamicJson();
        initDsBuilder.UseVector();
        await using var initDataSource = initDsBuilder.Build();
        var initOptionsBuilder = new Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContextOptionsBuilder<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>();
        initOptionsBuilder.UseNpgsql(initDataSource, npgsqlOptions => {
          npgsqlOptions.UseVector();
          // Whizbang custom function translators (JsonbSet, etc.), required for collective-apply ExecuteUpdate.
          npgsqlOptions.UseWhizbangFunctions();
          npgsqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3, maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5), errorCodesToAdd: null);
        });
        initOptionsBuilder.UseWhizbangPhysicalFields();
        var initOptions = initOptionsBuilder.Options;
        await using var initDbContext = new global::TestApp.TestDbContext(initOptions);
        await initDbContext.EnsureWhizbangDatabaseInitializedAsync(logger, initConnStr, scope.ServiceProvider, ct, initCommandTimeoutSeconds);
      } else {
        var dbContext = scope.ServiceProvider.GetService<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>();
        if (dbContext == null) {
          logger?.LogDebug("{DbContextName} not registered in DI, skipping initialization", "TestDbContext");
          return;
        }
        await dbContext.EnsureWhizbangDatabaseInitializedAsync(logger, null, scope.ServiceProvider, ct, initCommandTimeoutSeconds);
      }
    });

    // Lets the Assess verdict tell whether this context's schema is current (nothing to apply or convert)
    DbContextInitializationRegistry.RegisterSchemaCurrencyCheck<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>(async (sp, ct) => {
      using var scope = sp.CreateScope();
      var dbContext = scope.ServiceProvider.GetService<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>();
      return dbContext is null ? null : await dbContext.IsWhizbangSchemaCurrentAsync(ct, scope.ServiceProvider);
    });

    // Lets the rollback gate judge a recorded change this build defines identically as current, whoever applied it
    DbContextInitializationRegistry.RegisterSchemaContent<global::TestApp.TestDbContext>(
      (dbContext, sp) => dbContext.GetWhizbangSchemaContent(sp));

  }
}
